_comment: Default lab theme. Cyan + magenta + yellow on near-black; sans-serif. Mermaid uses the built-in dark theme (mermaid_builtin), so themeVariables are not derived.

palette._comment: stroke1/2/3 align with data.cat[0..2] so the same logical role (primary/secondary/tertiary) resolves to the same color across vega categorical, scene3d wireframes, and animated_svg $token substitution. The saturated neon trio (#00ffff/#ff00ff/#ffff00) now lives at data.cat[3..5] for opt-in saturation instead of being the default scene3d strokes.
